story.fullStory:
Goldfrapp's "Number 1" — original release 2005. "Number 1" is a song by English electronic music duo Goldfrapp from their third studio album, Supernature (2005).

Artist: Goldfrapp · Title: Number 1 · Album: Number 1 · Year: 2005 · Genre: Electro · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Goldfrapp - Number 1.mp4.

Written and produced by Alison Goldfrapp and Will Gregory, the song features a synthesiser and bass guitar arrangement and was written about the importance and meaningfulness that somebody shares with another, despite that it might not necessarily last.

The song was released as the album's second single in October 2005 to positive reviews from music critics.
